trust_boundaries.name: TB-1 ZSA delta: LookupRangeCheck4_5BConfig (optimized 4/5-bit lookup)
trust_boundaries.assumption: The optimized 4/5/K-bit combined lookup soundly binds a witnessed word to <=4 or <=5 bits via the table_range_check_tag lookup, AND the running-sum / short-lookup paths are mutually exclusive per row.
trust_boundaries.evidence: utilities/lookup_range_check.rs:504-859. New code vs upstream (zcash/halo2 only ships LookupRangeCheckConfig). Soundness of the tag binding must be proven.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-2 ZSA delta: Sinsemilla allow_init_from_private_point
trust_boundaries.assumption: Initializing the Sinsemilla hash accumulator from a private (witnessed) point Q does not break domain separation or allow a prover to choose Q adversarially to forge a hash/commitment collision.
trust_boundaries.evidence: sinsemilla/chip/hash_to_point.rs:72-214. Gated by config.allow_init_from_private_point; returns Error::IllegalHashFromPrivatePoint otherwise.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-3 Variable-base scalar mul overflow / canonicity
trust_boundaries.assumption: overflow_check correctly enforces that the 255-bit decomposition of alpha represents a canonical scalar < q, preventing a malleable/non-canonical scalar.
trust_boundaries.evidence: ecc/chip/mul/overflow.rs. Constraints s_check, recovery, lo_zero, s_minus_lo_130_check, canonicity.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-4 ecc complete addition gate (12 polynomials)
trust_boundaries.assumption: The complete-addition gate correctly handles all exceptional cases (P=O, Q=O, P=-Q, P=Q) so the output is the true group sum for any witnessed input points.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-5 witness_point on-curve check
trust_boundaries.assumption: A witnessed point is constrained to be either identity-(0,0) or a valid curve point y^2 = x^3 + 5; non-identity witness rejects (0,0).
trust_boundaries.evidence: ecc/chip/witness_point.rs:48-86. Non-parenthesized q_point*x*curve_eqn form kept for pinned-vk compatibility.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-6 Sinsemilla Merkle path/root
trust_boundaries.assumption: MerkleCRH path hashing binds position bits (left/right ordering) and the layer, so a prover cannot produce a valid path to a root for a leaf not in the tree.
trust_boundaries.evidence: sinsemilla/merkle.rs, sinsemilla/merkle/chip.rs. Uses cond_swap for sibling ordering + Sinsemilla hash.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-7 cond_swap
trust_boundaries.assumption: The conditional swap gate constrains the swap bit to be boolean and the outputs to be a correct swap/no-swap of the inputs.
trust_boundaries.evidence: utilities/cond_swap.rs. Used by Merkle sibling ordering; bool-check of the swap flag is critical.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-8 Poseidon Pow5 sponge
trust_boundaries.assumption: The Pow5 Poseidon chip correctly implements the permutation (full/partial rounds, MDS, round constants) and sponge padding for the configured rate/width, matching halo2_poseidon primitives.
trust_boundaries.evidence: poseidon/pow5.rs. Round constants and MDS come from halo2_poseidon dependency.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-9 decompose_running_sum
trust_boundaries.assumption: The running-sum decomposition gate enforces z_i = 2^WINDOW * z_{i+1} + k_i with k_i range-bounded, and (strict mode) z_final = 0.
trust_boundaries.evidence: utilities/decompose_running_sum.rs. Shared primitive underpinning scalar/field decompositions across ecc + sinsemilla.

route_dispositions.summary: Variable-base scalar-mul incomplete-addition addend is not constrained to the base point (M-1, Medium, PoC-confirmed, caller-mitigated). Sinsemilla private-init and incomplete-add exceptional cases reviewed (INFO-1/INFO-2). LookupRangeCheck4_5BConfig tag binding proven sound (O-1).
Poseidon Pow5 S-box/rounds/sponge wiring sound; parameters delegated to halo2_poseidon (out of scope). SHA-256 uses FIPS 180-4 constants, gated off by default. No findings.
add_incomplete/complete/mul_fixed reviewed; only Lookup type-parameter generification changed vs upstream; no gate logic change. No findings beyond by-design INFO-2.
Merkle root extraction (point.x()) and layer/position binding via cond_swap verified sound (TB-6).
#![deny(unsafe_code)] enforced. ~226 unwrap/expect and ~237 shifts operate on compile-time-constant sizes, not proving-time DoS. INFO-3: stale todo!() stubs (maintainability only).

verified_findings.summary: Variable-base scalar-mul incomplete-addition addend is not constrained to the base point. incomplete.rs assigns the addend (x_P,y_P) via assign_advice (value only), never copy_advice; only z/lambda_1 are equality-enabled. PoC-confirmed: the gate reaches verify()==Ok with a forged addend [7]T != T (accumulator pinned to [2]T); negative control proves liveness; an end-to-end forge hook showed result != [alpha]*base. Downgraded Critical->Medium because deployed callers (Orchard, all in-tree tests) pin the result via constrain_equal. Supersedes the earlier INFO-2 by-design note for this file.

Sinsemilla hash_to_point_with_private_init shifts the on-curve + domain-separation guarantee of Q to the caller. FALSE POSITIVE for a soundness vuln in this crate — all in-tree callers pass a constrained in-circuit Q and the path is gated by Error::IllegalHashFromPrivatePoint. Documented as a caller obligation for downstream integrators.

Incomplete-addition gates do not constrain x_p != x_a at the constraint level; the exceptional case is rejected only at witness-assignment time. BY DESIGN — the documented upstream Zcash incomplete-addition pattern whose soundness follows from the completeness theorems. Unchanged by ZSA.

Stale unimplemented stubs: todo!() at ecc/chip.rs:501 and todo!("unimplemented for halo2_gadgets v0.1.0") in mul_fixed/full_width.rs:134 and short.rs:130. Reachable only by circuit-author API misuse, not a malicious prover's witness. Maintainability note.

Tag-row table load emits tag=4 only for idx<2^4 and tag=5 only for idx<2^5; lookup tuple (z_cur,num_bits) satisfiable iff z_cur<2^num_bits. Selectors are fixed columns. SOUND.

fp_check_verdicts.verdict: INFO-1 (FALSE POSITIVE for in-tree soundness; documented caller obligation).

add_incomplete/complete/mul_fixed reviewed; no gate logic change vs upstream.

extensions.scope_note: halo2_gadgets folder ONLY. In-circuit constraint gadgets for Halo2/Orchard on the Pallas curve. Modules: ecc, poseidon, sinsemilla, sha256 (gated behind unstable-sha256-gadget), utilities. ~20K LoC. Crate sets #![deny(unsafe_code)].

dimension_map_anomalies.description: The combined lookup multiplexes three modes (running-sum, short, 4/5-bit-tagged) into one lookup input via selector arithmetic. Must verify q_running, q_range_check_4, q_range_check_5 cannot be simultaneously asserted in a way that lets a >5-bit value pass.

Q goes from a fixed public generator to a witnessed private NonIdentityEccPoint. Need to find every enabler of allow_init_from_private_point and confirm Q is a constrained output of a prior in-circuit hash.
dimension_map_anomalies.severity_hint: HIGH (if Q unconstrained) / INFORMATIONAL (if always a constrained sub-hash)

dimension_map_anomalies.description: RunningSum::witness_short asserts num_bits < K but witness_short_check asserts num_bits <= K. Confirm no off-by-one lets a K-bit-plus value through at the boundary.
Incomplete addition assumes x_p != x_a; the guard is a witness-time check, NOT a constraint. Verify the gate (not just the assign-time guard) rejects x_p==x_a.
dimension_map_anomalies.severity_hint: MEDIUM (standard pattern, but verify constraint-level enforcement)

dimension_map_anomalies.description: Dummy lambda_2 and x_p are assigned 0 on the final row. Confirm the final-row gate zeroes their contribution and no rotation feeds these dummies to a live constraint.

threat_model_notes: Attacker model: a malicious PROVER who fully controls all private witnesses and wants a verifying proof of a false statement (soundness break). The verifier/keygen and the SINSEMILLA_S table / Poseidon constants are trusted.

Primary risk class for an in-circuit gadget library: UNDER-CONSTRAINED witnesses, exceptional-case handling in EC arithmetic, non-canonical scalar/field decompositions, and missing boolean/range constraints.
NOT in scope: Fiat-Shamir transcript / proof-system soundness (halo2_proofs), trusted setup (Halo2/IPA has none), key authentication, replay.
CSPRNG: not applicable — this crate creates no keys/nonces.
Most-changed-vs-upstream (highest priority): (1) LookupRangeCheck4_5BConfig, (2) Sinsemilla allow_init_from_private_point, (3) OrchardZSA trait-genericization of chips.

reaudit_incomplete_rs.trigger: User-requested deep re-audit of ecc/chip/mul/incomplete.rs with explicit instruction NOT to assume safety from prior human audits.
reaudit_incomplete_rs.claim: The variable-base scalar-mul INCOMPLETE-ADDITION gate does not constrain the addend (x_P,y_P) to equal the base point.

poc.forged_addend: verify()==Ok(()) with accumulator pinned to [2]T constants and addend forged to [7]T != T
poc.negative_control: corrupt lambda2 += 1 -> ConstraintNotSatisfied -> proves the reconstructed gate is LIVE
poc.end_to_end: A test-only forge hook into the REAL EccChip::mul confirmed the forged addend produces result != [alpha]*base; reaching verify() end-to-end is blocked only by test-only asserts.

reaudit_incomplete_rs.severity_rationale: Base class is a soundness under-constraint in a core EC gadget (Critical if a direct end-to-end break against a realistic caller were demonstrated). Downgraded to Medium: deployed callers pin the RESULT via constrain_equal, making a forged-addend result UNSATISFIABLE.
reaudit_incomplete_rs.caveat: This is original upstream zcash/halo2 code (predates ZSA), deployed in Orchard for years. Orchard's result-pinning mitigates it. The finding is that the gadget's internal constraints alone do not bind the incomplete-addition addend.
reaudit_incomplete_rs.remediation: Either (a) copy-constrain the incomplete-addition addend cells to base.x/base.y, OR (b) explicitly document on EccInstructions::mul that the returned point equals [scalar]*base only when the caller binds the result.
reaudit_incomplete_rs.next_route: crypto-report-writer (Medium finding) + maintainer escalation. NOT index-worthy as a confirmed exploit.
